# Part II: One Guide, Many Audiences {.unnumbered .part}

You work for London's tourism office. The brief: write **one** visitor guide, then reuse it for
every audience, from a web page for visitors to a dashboard for managers, a Word brief for
partners and a printed flyer for walk-ins, and publish it all as a website. Every visitor
number comes from a cited table, so when the data change, every version can be rebuilt with
one command.

Make the project folder next to the workshop repository you cloned in Chapter 3, so that its
checkpoints are always at `../quarto-workshop/checkpoints/`:

```text
~                      your home folder
├── quarto-workshop/   the clone from Chapter 3
└── london-guide/      this part's project
```

::: {.you}
```bash
cd ~
mkdir -p london-guide && cd london-guide
claude
```
:::
